### Checklist
- [ ] Every item I added or changed was checked against its own `source_url`, and the source says what the item says.
- [ ] No source outside the allowed list was used.
- [ ] Every touched item's `as_of` is the day I read its source; the file `as_of` is the newest of them.
- [ ] Changes older than 12 months (from the file `as_of`) were removed; destination statuses were reset where their
      release dropped out of the window.
- [ ] zh-Hant length limits respected (group ≤ 80, milestone ≤ 40, change ≤ 60).
- [ ] Hong Kong Airlines items come only from its own site (or its public annual report).
- [ ] The validate Action is green.
